bodies.name: Sejm Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej (Sejm of the Republic of Poland)
bodies.layout: A narrow, centred legacy layout on a pale grey page. The header carries the eagle crest, 'Sejm Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej', the term number ('X kadencja') and a constitutional motto, with font-size (A, A+, A++) and contrast toggles plus social icons on the right. A dark horizontal menu in capitals sits below (Strona główna, Prace Sejmu, Posłowie, Dla mediów, O Sejmie, Publikacje, Archiwum). The body splits into a 'Prace bieżące' list of sittings, agendas and votes, a month calendar widget with keyboard instructions, and a dated news list. A capitalised link footer closes the page.
ui_patterns: Term number ('X kadencja') under the institution name
Constitutional motto in quotation marks in the header
A / A+ / A++ font-size and yellow-on-black contrast toggles
All-caps dark main menu
Calendar widget with written keyboard shortcuts
Dated news list (DD.MM.YYYY - headline)
Cookie notice where not blocking counts as consent
Footer of capitalised links (Marszałek Sejmu, Wicemarszałkowie…)

bodies.name: Kancelaria Prezesa Rady Ministrów (Chancellery of the Prime Minister) - gov.pl/premier
bodies.layout: The gov.pl portal uses a unified template shared across all ministries, with a slim top utility bar containing the mObywatel login, EU flag icon, sign-language interpreter toggle, BIP icon, and language switcher. Below sits the Kancelaria Prezesa Rady Ministrow masthead with a hamburger-triggered mega-menu covering Premier, O Kancelarii, O Radzie Ministrow, Expose, Aktualnosci and Kontakt. The homepage body is organized into modular card sections (Zapowiedzi, Aktualnosci, Komunikaty CIR, Decyzje rzadu, Informacja publiczna, Rada Ministrow) each rendered as a horizontally scrollable row of image-led news cards with dates and Warsaw/city datelines. A photo grid of all Council of Ministers members with portrait thumbnails and titles appears mid-page, and the footer carries the KPRM address, RODO/GDPR clause link, accessibility declaration, and the standard gov.pl multi-column footer with EU funding logos and the Polish eagle godlo icon.
ui_patterns: unified gov.pl mega-menu template shared across all ministries
mObywatel (digital citizen ID app) login button in header
sign-language interpreter widget link (tlumacz jezyka migowego)
BIP (Biuletyn Informacji Publicznej) icon link
EN/PL and Ukrainian-language switcher with Ukraine flag icon for refugee content
horizontally scrollable news-card carousels grouped by category (Zapowiedzi, Aktualnosci, Komunikaty CIR)
Council of Ministers photo directory grid with round/square portrait thumbnails
cookie/privacy settings link and RODO clause in footer
EU funding co-financing logos in footer (Fundusze Europejskie)

bodies.name: Centralne Biuro Antykorupcyjne (Central Anticorruption Bureau, CBA)
bodies.layout: CBA's homepage opens with skip-links (menu, content, search, sitemap) followed by a dark masthead bearing the full agency name and a contrast-mode and font-size toolbar for accessibility. A top-right strip holds the English-language switch and a direct BIP link. The primary menu is a dense vertical/horizontal hybrid listing O nas, Aktualnosci, Kontrole, Projekty, Rekrutacja, Foto, Antykorupcja, and Kontakt, several with flyout sub-items. The body is dominated by a rotating Topnews carousel of enforcement-action headlines with dates, a numeric Statystyki panel showing training counts, followed by a stacked list of dated Aktualnosci CBA press items describing arrests and investigations, then a Kalendarium date-picker widget and a prominent 'Zgloc korupcje' (Report corruption) call-to-action block with phone/form/written options. The footer repeats the full menu tree plus the Warsaw address, corruption hotline number, and links to the accessibility declaration, sitemap, and privacy policy.
ui_patterns: skip-menu accessibility links at page top
contrast-mode toggle and font-size (normal/medium/large) accessibility toolbar
direct BIP (Biuletyn Informacji Publicznej) link in header
rotating Topnews carousel of enforcement/arrest headlines with publish dates
'Zglos korupcje' (Report corruption) prominent CTA block with phone/form/in-person options
Kalendarium (calendar) date-picker widget for archived announcements
numeric statistics panel (training counts, e-learning participants)
PDF/DOCX 'tekst odczytywalny maszynowo' (machine-readable text) download blocks for accessibility
official crest/patron emblem references (Archaniol Gabriel patron saint of the service)
